eps.d: Zipper learns that he's to inherit a large fortune, but must claim it by noon.

eps.t: Half a Map is Better Than None
eps.d: The gang find a treasure map but Catchum learns about it too.
Catchum steals the clubhouse and Bingo's attempt to get it back results in it rolling away.
Montgomery builds a robot moose named Hermie for the science fair but it's sabotaged by Catchum, causing Hermie to go on a rampage.
The gang enter a kite-flying competition.
The gang end up in the mountains where Zipper is taken by a strange beast.
Woolma runs away, thinking her friends forgot her birthday, and befriends a skunk carny.
The gang become detectives and search for crook Sammy the Sneak.

eps.t: The Get Along Gang Go Hollywood
eps.d: Montgomery's uncle Marty comes to town to shoot a movie but is framed for bank robbery.
While hosting Dottie's cousin Wilton, the gang end up in a mine that's haunted by a ghost.

eps.t: A Pinch of This, a Dash of That
eps.d: Montgomery creates an anti-gravity formula and Bingo tries to sell it.
Bingo must overcome his fear of water to stop the dam from breaking.
The gang work to save the travel museum.
The gang pick up trash so the swamp won't be the site of a new dump but Catchum keeps messing it up.
The gang and Catchum hunt for stories that'll make them junior reporters.
Zipper and Bingo get caught in the middle of a gang of crooks hiding in the lighthouse.
The gang help Mr. Hoofnagel relive his glory days as a pilot.
Portia takes over Braker's paper route for money to buy a bike.

eps.t: The Get Along Gang Minus One
eps.d: Bingo learns that he's moving away but the others don't believe him.
Both halves of the gang go camping and the girls fare better than the boys.
Bingo's athletic pen pal Susie comes to town and thinks that Zipper is Bingo.
Catchum takes over the school's parade float in a scheme to get free food.
Catchum and Leland frame the gang for slacking on a test and they plot revenge.
The gang run afoul of the Pig sisters and Catchum escalates the animosity between them.

eps.t: That's the Way the Cookie Crumbles
eps.d: The gang start a cookie-selling business but Catchum and Leland sow discontent among them.
The gang partake in winter fun while Zipper finds a rival in Officer Growler's nephew.
